newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-VILLA DENY ARSENAL TOP SPOT WITH DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-VILLA DENY ARSENAL TOP SPOT WITH DRAW.

text.p: Aston Villa twice came from behind to draw 2-2 at Arsenal on Saturday -- a result which deprived the Londoners top place in the English premier league.
Ian Wright put Arsenal ahead in the 13th minute with his 22nd goal of the season and the home side dominated the rest of the half, denying Villa a single shot on target.

But in a frantic seven-minute spell after the interval, Savo Milosevic pulled Villa level, Paul Merson restored Arsenal's lead and, within seconds of the restart, Dwight Yorke scored to ensure a point for Villa.
The outcome, a repeat of their first league clash in September, left Arsenal two points behind Liverpool.
